title: Residue-field projective dimension in a regular local ring
statement: Let R be a commutative regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], with maximal ideal m. The projective dimension [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension] of R/m, equivalently of any universe-shrunk copy of this module, equals spanFinrank(m), the minimal number of generators of m.

source.place: Theorem projectiveDimension_quotient_maximalIdeal, lines 110-120, with exists_isRegular_ofList_eq_maximalIdeal, lines 101-108, and Mathlib ModuleCat.projectiveDimension_quotient_eq_length.

proof.text: The fully proved source theorem exists_isRegular_ofList_eq_maximalIdeal supplies a regular sequence rs generating m with length spanFinrank(m). Its proof inducts on the generator number: choose x in m outside m^2, pass to the regular quotient R/(x), lift its generating regular sequence, and prepend x; the empty sequence handles m = 0.
Apply Mathlib ModuleCat.projectiveDimension_quotient_eq_length to rs. This identifies the projective dimension of the universe-shrunk R/Ideal.ofList(rs) with the length of rs.

Rewrite Ideal.ofList(rs) = m and length(rs) = spanFinrank(m). The resulting equality is exactly the source theorem. It holds in embedding dimension zero as well, when R is a field and its nonzero residue field is projective.

theorem IsRegularLocalRing.projectiveDimension_quotient_maximalIdeal {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] [Small.{v} R] :
    projectiveDimension (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R))) =
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
